move.name: Solar Beam
move.text: Absorbs light for a second (instantly if it’s already Sunny; it doesn’t set Sun), then fires a wide beam across the whole board. Power 349 (150% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Fire Blast
move.text: A fiery blast around its target: the ground burns for 3s, burning anyone who steps on it (bigger in Sun). Power 467 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Hydro Pump
move.text: A jet that pushes its target back 2 hexes (if it collides, both are knocked airborne), then it withdraws into its shell with a shield. The shield adds 120% of its Defense (Choice Specs and Calcium don’t raise it). Power 610 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Sleep Powder
move.text: Scatters powder over the tightest enemy cluster and puts them to sleep. Power 200 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Twineedle
move.text: Leaps at its target and stings it 3 times; deals 30% more if it is already poisoned. +30% damage vs. poisoned targets. Power 150 (120% Attack)

move.name: Whirlwind
move.text: A gale pushes away those next to its target and it lands a huge wing strike, 30% stronger if the target is left alone. If its prey has already fallen, it soars up and dives on the enemy that has dealt the most damage. Can be a critical hit. Power 646 (120% Attack)

move.name: Super Fang
move.text: Bites the enemy with the highest HP and takes 60% of its current HP (48% vs. legendaries and 3★). Its next 2 attacks deal 40% more.

move.name: Hyper Beam
move.text: A beam that crosses the whole board. Afterwards it must recharge for a moment. Power 882/1940 (90% · 40%)

move.name: Earthquake
move.text: Shakes the whole board: damages every enemy (except Flying types) and slightly hurts adjacent allies. Then returns 40% of the damage it has taken to adjacent enemies. Also hits with 120% of its Defense (Iron raises it; Choice Band and Protein don’t). Power 249 (60% Attack)

move.name: Leech Life
move.text: Bites its target and drains its HP: heals for almost all the damage. Scales strongly with Attack items. Power 298/539 (160% Attack)

move.name: Drill Run
move.text: Spins like a drill horn-first through a line of 3 hexes: Ground damage that can be a critical hit. Can be a critical hit. Power 567 (100% Attack)

move.name: Seismic Toss
move.text: Grabs its target and throws it 3 hexes back: it lands damaging those nearby. Power 1643 (100% Attack)

move.name: Dig
move.text: Burrows, spends 1s underground where nothing can reach it, then its three heads pop up under its target: three headbutts that can be critical hits; the third knocks it airborne. Can be a critical hit. Power 131/315 (110% Attack)

move.name: Wild Charge
move.text: Electrifies itself: its next 5 attacks (7 at 3★) hit harder and jump to 2 nearby enemies, and it attacks faster for 4s. The last one paralyzes.

move.name: Fire Spin
move.text: Wraps its target and the 2 enemies closest to it in fire vortexes that trap them (they cannot move) and burn them. Power 228/353/558 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Water Pulse
move.text: Water rings at the enemy with the most Energy: drains it, blocks it from charging for a while and confuses it for 1s. Power 572/926 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Petal Dance
move.text: Dances for 3s, raining petals on its target and those around it; each Dance in the combat hits 20% harder than the last. Afterwards it gets dizzy. Power 191 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Teleport
move.text: Teleports away from whoever is hitting it while keeping its target in range (if there is no room, it stays) and its next 3 attacks carry a psychic strike; the 3rd lowers the target’s Sp. Def by 25% for 4s. Power 421 (180% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Night Shade
move.text: Sinks into its shadow and reappears in the enemy backline: damages those beside it and scares them: they flee 1 hex and cannot attack it for 1.5s. Power 732 (120% Sp. Atk)

gastly.passive: Its abilities ignore defenses and deal +40% damage · −20% HP

move.name: Dynamic Punch
move.text: Hypnotizes it for an instant and lands a punch that wakes it up for double damage, drags it 2 hexes without letting go and leaves it confused for 1.5s. +100% damage vs. sleeping targets. Power 563 (100% Attack)

move.name: Rollout
move.text: Curls into a ball and rolls 3 hexes through enemies (pushing them aside), leaving sand for 3s: they miss half of their attacks. Hits with its Defense, and each Rollout in the combat hits 25% harder. Taunts nearby enemies for 2s: they can only attack it. Then returns 40% of the damage it has taken to adjacent enemies. Also hits with 100% of its Defense (Iron raises it; Choice Band and Protein don’t).

move.name: Wrap
move.text: Coils around its target for 3.5s: both stay still, the trapped one can only attack it, and every half second it squeezes and poisons it. Power 305/528 (100% Attack)

move.name: Sing
move.text: Sings in a cone toward its target: puts everyone it reaches to sleep and doodles on their faces; while asleep, they take 30% more damage from everyone. Power 198/350/589 (60% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Growth
move.text: The mushroom grows: each time it uses this it gains 14% Attack and 6% lifesteal until the end of combat. Every 3 uses it releases spores that put adjacent enemies to sleep for 2s. Taunts nearby enemies for 2s: they can only attack it. Then returns 40% of the damage it has taken to adjacent enemies.

move.name: Charge
move.text: 173/263/411 (100% Sp. Atk) to nearby enemies; stores 1079 charge and adds 488 each time it uses it, when it faints it explodes 2 tiles around with all its charge.

move.name: Inferno
move.text: Gallops 5 hexes in a straight line wreathed in flames, passing through enemies, and leaves a fire trail for 3.5s that burns anyone who steps on it. Power 250/403 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Roar
move.text: Roars: pushes adjacent enemies 2 hexes away and scares them, except its target, which is left alone, and then rams it with a Take Down. Power 359/533 (100% Attack)

move.name: Thunder Wave
move.text: Zaps its target and leaves an electric field around it for 5s that paralyzes anyone inside. Power 393/591/900 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Amnesia
move.text: Goes blank for a second, then covers itself with a big shield. When it breaks or after 4s, part of the absorbed damage hits adjacent enemies. Taunts nearby enemies for 2s: they can only attack it. The shield adds 150% of its Sp. Def (Choice Specs and Calcium don’t raise it). Power 619/628/650 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Bind
move.text: Burrows and emerges next to its target: knocks it and those beside it airborne and coils around it: it is trapped for 2.5s (cannot move). Then returns 40% of the damage it has taken to adjacent enemies. Also hits with 65% of its Defense (Iron raises it; Choice Band and Protein don’t). Power 157/230/323 (40% Attack)

move.name: Swords Dance
move.text: Sharpens its scythes: its next 3 attacks (4 at 2★, 5 at 3★) deal 80% more and are Bug-type critical hits: super effective against Psychic and Grass.

move.name: High Jump Kick
move.text: Jumps at the farthest enemy and knocks it airborne. If the target falls before it lands, it crashes. Power 704/1156/1789 (100% Attack)

move.name: Elemental Punches
move.text: Its next 3 attacks are Fire Punch (burns), Ice Punch (slows) and Thunder Punch (paralyzes), all much stronger.

move.name: Lovely Kiss
move.text: Blows a kiss at its target and puts it to sleep. Power 500/806/1228 (60% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Thunder Punch
move.text: An electric punch that paralyzes; the ground around stays electrified for 2s, paralyzing anyone who steps on it. Power 320/481/690 (70% · 50%)

move.name: Smokescreen
move.text: Spits a cone of fire that burns and leaves smoke for 2s: enemies inside miss 1 in 4 attacks. Power 406/641/956 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Ice Beam
move.text: In a line: 289/420 (100% Sp. Atk) to each enemy; −40% Atk speed 3s, freezes 1s.

move.name: Egg Bomb
move.text: Throws 6 exploding eggs at the tightest enemy clusters. Power 535/828 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Bonemerang
move.text: Throws its bone along a 6-hex line: it passes through everyone and comes back, hitting each one twice. Scales strongly with Attack items. Power 199/308 (160% Attack)

move.name: Last Resort
move.text: Chains Quick Attack and Bite (makes it flinch), then finishes with Last Resort, a huge blow. Power 1046 (100% Attack)

move.name: Haze
move.text: Icy haze over its target and those nearby: removes their shields and buffs, and shields itself. Power 354/605 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Shock Wave
move.text: Bristles its fur and fires 4 electric needles at its target (one more for every 20% attack speed from its items); the last one paralyzes it. Power 132/213 (80% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Flare Blitz
move.text: Charges its target wreathed in flames: big damage and a burn, and it takes a little of the blow. Deals 30% more to targets already burning. +30% damage vs. burned targets. Power 525/936 (100% Attack)

move.name: Extreme Speed
move.text: Vanishes and rams 3 different foes: its target, the one closest to it and the one with the least HP, where it reappears. It can’t be targeted between rams. Power 1114 (100% Attack)

dratini.passive: +25% HP, damage and Attack speed · needs 20% more Energy

move.name: Surf
move.text: A wave sweeps the whole enemy side: damages everyone and pushes them back. Power 243/417/686 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Body Slam
move.text: Body Slam: crushes those around it with its weight (hits harder the more HP it has), paralyzes and taunts them. Below a third of its HP it uses Rest: sleeps 2s and recovers part of its HP (it takes more damage while asleep). Taunts nearby enemies for 2s: they can only attack it. Also hits with 10% of its max HP (HP Up and Leftovers raise it; Choice Band and Protein don’t). Power 97/164/265 (50% Attack)

move.name: Fly
move.text: Soars out of reach and dives onto the rearmost enemy, knocking it and those beside it airborne. Can be a critical hit. Power 408/858/1368 (120% Attack)

move.name: Soft-Boiled
move.text: Throws eggs that heal the 3 most injured allies and speed them up. Heals more the more HP it has. Shields the most injured ally for 22% of its own HP. Each heal adds 6% of its max HP (Choice Specs and Calcium don’t raise it). Power 300/480/600

move.name: Swift
move.text: Fires a burst of never-missing stars at its target (if it falls, the rest go to the enemy closest to it). Power 195/321 (100% Attack)

move.name: Horn Drill
move.text: A big horn strike that also hits with its Defense: if its target is left below 25% HP, it knocks it out. Then returns 40% of the damage it has taken to adjacent enemies. Also hits with 60% of its Defense (Iron raises it; Choice Band and Protein don’t). Power 327/712/1231 (60% Attack)

move.name: Transform
move.text: Copies the most valuable enemy (never another Ditto): types, stats and ability; no healing.

move.name: Spike Cannon
move.text: Fires 5 spikes, each at a different enemy. Also hits with 50% of its Defense (Iron raises it; Choice Band and Protein don’t). Power 428/677 (80% Attack)

move.name: Rage
move.text: Charges in a straight line to the back, passing through everyone and knocking them airborne. Then, enraged, it attacks faster for 4s and its next 4 attacks hit harder and heal it. Each Rage in the combat hits 20% harder than the last. Power 254/423/682 (110% Attack)

move.name: Blizzard
move.text: Snow falls on the whole field: damages, slows and freezes every enemy. Power 276/468/673 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Thunder
move.text: A lightning bolt strikes every enemy, damaging and paralyzing those around each one. Power 243/425/820 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Sky Attack
move.text: Soars out of reach and dives across the board toward the densest cluster, hitting everyone in its path and setting the ground ablaze. Power 747/1322/2022 (100% Attack)

move.name: Psystrike
move.text: A wave that damages every enemy, knocks them airborne and pushes them back 3 hexes. Those who collide take extra damage. Power 306/520/880 (100% Sp. Atk)

move.name: Metronome
move.text: Uses a random ability.

koga.passive: Character Pokémon with its own look: ninja smoke that poisons and makes attacks miss.

giovanni.passive: Character Pokémon with its own look: Fury Swipes.

samurai.passive: Character Pokémon with its own look: Guillotine, a huge slash at its target.

porygon3.passive: Conversion changes its type to one that resists the last hit.

omastar.passive: Throws rocks and hides in its shell.

kabutops.passive: Leaps at the backmost enemy and slashes it.

pikachu-partner.passive: Hero Pikachu from the Partner Seal.

calcium.name: Calcium
calcium.text: +12% Special Attack (its ability's damage, heals and shields)

leftovers.name: Leftovers
leftovers.text: +10% HP ×2 · Restores 1% of its max HP per second

choice-specs.name: Choice Specs
choice-specs.text: +50% Special Attack (its ability's damage, heals and shields)

scope-lens.name: Scope Lens
scope-lens.text: +12% Attack · +8% Atk speed · +25% Crit chance (basic attacks and abilities that can crit); its crits deal ×1.9

life-orb.name: Life Orb
life-orb.text: +12% Attack · +12% Sp. Atk · +15% damage (basics and ability), rising up to +50% the less HP it has left

quick-claw.name: Quick Claw
quick-claw.text: +12% Sp. Atk · +8% Atk speed · Starts combat with +20% Energy and, after using its ability, starts the next one at 8% (each Claw adds up)

shell-bell.name: Shell Bell
shell-bell.text: +10% HP · +12% Sp. Atk · Drain: heals 15% of the direct damage it deals (attacks and abilities; burn and poison don't count)

focus-sash.name: Focus Sash
focus-sash.text: +10% HP · +8% Atk speed · Survives a lethal hit with 1 HP: becomes untargetable and inactive for 1s (enemies drop it as a target), is cleansed of damage-over-time effects, and returns with a shield worth 10% of its HP (once)

rocky-helmet.name: Rocky Helmet
rocky-helmet.text: +10% HP · +12% Attack · Returns 22% of the basic-attack damage it takes

assault-vest.name: Assault Vest
assault-vest.text: +20% Sp. Def ×2 · Takes 12% less damage from abilities

flame-orb.name: Flame Orb
flame-orb.text: +10% HP · +20% Defense · Every second, enemies within 1 hex lose 0.3% of their max HP and suffer Heal Block (−30% healing)

razor-fang.name: Razor Fang
razor-fang.text: +12% Attack · +20% Defense · Its basic attacks inflict Wear for 4s (−18% Defense and Sp. Def)

twisted-spoon.name: Twisted Spoon
twisted-spoon.text: +12% Sp. Atk · +20% Defense · Enemies its ability damages lose 18% Defense and Sp. Def for 4s (Wear)

poison-barb.name: Poison Barb
poison-barb.text: +8% Atk speed · +20% Defense · Its basic attacks inflict Heal Block for 4s (−30% healing); deals 50% more damage to shields

protector.name: Protector
protector.text: +20% Defense ×2 · Takes 12% less damage from basic attacks

eviolite.name: Metal Powder
eviolite.text: +20% Defense · +20% Sp. Def · +6% Defense and Sp. Def for each enemy targeting it
eviolite.short: +6% Def & Sp. Def per enemy on it

sitrus-berry.name: Sitrus Berry
sitrus-berry.text: +10% HP · +20% Sp. Def · When it drops below 50% HP, heals 20% of its max HP (once)

expert-belt.name: Expert Belt
expert-belt.text: +12% Attack · +20% Sp. Def · Its basic attacks use its best type: if super effective, +30% damage (never less). Its super effective abilities, +45%

light-clay.name: Light Clay
light-clay.text: +12% Sp. Atk · +20% Sp. Def · Its ability's shields, heals and seeds are 30% stronger, and so are those its allies within 1 hex receive

mental-herb.name: Mental Herb
mental-herb.text: +8% Atk speed · +20% Sp. Def · Instantly shakes off a crowd control (sleep, paralysis, confusion, freeze…) and gains +20% attack speed for 3s. Recharges in 8s (each copy is one more charge)

water.desc: Water types gain +{v} extra Energy per attack.

grass.desc: Grass types regenerate {v}% of their max HP per second.

electric.name: Electric
electric.desc: The whole team starts with +{v} Energy. Electric types also shock adjacent enemies when they use their ability (damage and 3s paralysis: −50% attack speed and 1 in 4 attacks fails).

ice.name: Ice
ice.desc: Ice types' attacks slow the target by {v}% for 2s.

poison.name: Poison
poison.desc: Poison types' attacks poison: {v} damage/s for 4s.

flying.desc: Flying types dodge {v}% of basic attacks.

text.line: Selling what you didn’t buy this round: +1
text.detail: Selling a Pokémon you already had when the round started: +1 gold. Buying and selling in the same round pays nothing.
Every round your win or loss streak already pays gold, you get +1 more.
When you collect each round: +1 gold per 6 you have saved, up to +7. Replaces the normal interest.
+1 gold per round from the moment you pick it; every 4 rounds collected it grows by +1, with no cap.
If your bench is empty when combat starts, +3 XP when the round ends.
+1 XP at the end of every round, and each XP purchase gives you 5 XP.
Each round, your first shop reroll is free. If you don’t use it, it doesn’t carry over.
Lines you already have on your board or bench show up ×1.3 as often in your shop.
Pick 1 of 3 legendaries from the pool; it arrives at 1★. No answer: the first; none left: its gold. Costs −15 HP.
2 random components now, then 1 more every 4 rounds, with no cap.
You choose a component 2 times, each time from 6 options.
Each of your {T} gains +3% HP and +3% damage per {T} on your board, itself included. Doesn’t add to the trait.
The {T} emblem (its holder also counts as {T}) and a cost 1 or 2 {T} Pokémon at 1★.
The {T} emblem, +1 to the {T} trait count, and your {T} Pokémon get +12% HP and +12% damage.
+22 gold now. At the start of each of the next 8 rounds you lose 3 player HP (it never eliminates you).

text.line: Each loss in a row: +3 on win
text.detail: Each loss in a row is a charge. When you win, you collect 3 gold per charge and 1 component per 3 charges.
Only offered above 30 player HP. Your HP: −30. In return: 1 completed items and +15% damage for your team.
In 6 rounds the egg lets you choose, from your Seals: 30 gold or a cost-4 Pokémon at 2★.
One board slot fewer than your level gives. In return, your whole team gets +20% HP and +20% damage.
You can field 1 more Pokémon than your level gives, for the rest of the game.
Right now, each of your Pokémon turns into a line 1 cost higher, up to cost 3, keeping its stars and items.
Every 6s of combat, your whole team gains +10 Energy; your Water Pokémon, +10 more.
When a round ends and you never rerolled the shop in it, +2 gold.
+3 gold for each rival eliminated in the round, as long as you are still alive.
In every fight, PvP or PvE, +1 gold for every 3 foes your team knocks out.
+4 XP now, and +1 XP at the end of every round until stage 2 is over.

text.line: On level up: +2 gold, 1 free reroll
text.detail: Every time you level up: +2 gold and 1 free shop reroll that round.
Shinies show up ×5 as often in your shop. A shiny has better stats than a normal one.
Your shop: +8 points of cost-4 odds, taken from cost 1. Only if cost 4 already shows up at your level.

text.line: 1 card of your traits every shop
text.detail: The first card of every shop roll is of a type from your active traits.
Shinies show up ×3 as often in your shop, and each shiny you buy gives you +4 gold.
+2 Magnets (they take the items off a Pokémon, back into your bag) and +1 random component.

text.line: +1 component; loose ones change each round
text.detail: +1 component now. At the start of every round, the loose components in your bag turn into random others.
In every PvE round, +1 component if you win and +2 if you lose.
−15 player HP now (it never eliminates you). In return, you choose 1 combined item out of 4.

text.line: +1 gold per round per 15 HP lost
text.detail: When you collect each round, +1 gold for every 15 player HP you are missing.

text.line: Streak: each win pays +1 more; broken, +1 component
text.detail: Each PvP win in a row pays 1 gold per win in the streak: 1, 2, 3… Broken after 2+: +1 component.

text.line: 3 rounds without base income; then +6 each
text.detail: For the next 3 rounds you get no base income. After that, +6 extra gold per round for the rest of the game.

text.line: In 6 rounds: a cost-4 Rock Pokémon
text.detail: In 6 rounds you get a cost-4 Rock Pokémon at 1★.
Nothing now. At the start of 5-2: 2 random combined items, another chosen from 3, and +30 gold.
Your team: +10% crit chance, and their abilities can crit as well.
The first ability of each of your Pokémon in a fight needs 30% less Energy.
Your team: +20% crit. Every crit gives the attacker +5% more crit until the fight ends.
When combat starts, each of your Pokémon has a shield of 15% of its HP; whatever is left fades after 4s.

text.line: Immune to status for the first 5s
text.detail: Your team can’t get status conditions (burn, poison, sleep, paralysis, freeze, slow…) during the first 5s of combat.

text.line: First to fall returns in 3s at 40% HP
text.detail: The first of your Pokémon that would faint holds on at 1 HP, sits out 3s untouchable, and returns with 40% HP.
Status conditions your team applies (burn, poison, sleep, slow…) last 50% longer.

text.line: +8% damage per status on the foe
text.detail: Your Pokémon deal +8% damage for each different status condition on the foe they hit.
Your team’s basic attacks have a 10% chance to put the foe to sleep for 1s; that foe can’t sleep again for 6s.

text.line: Rain unless rival weather; your Water +10 Energy
text.detail: It rains in your fights, for both sides: Water moves get stronger, Fire moves weaker. Your Water Pokémon start with +10 Energy.

text.line: Sun unless rival weather; your Grass regen ×1.5
text.detail: It’s sunny in your fights, for both sides: Fire moves get stronger, Water moves weaker. Your Grass Pokémon regenerate ×1.5.

text.line: Sand unless rival weather; hurts all but Rock/Ground
text.detail: Sandstorm in your fights, for both sides: anyone not Rock or Ground loses HP every second, and Rock Pokémon gain Sp. Def.

text.line: Hail unless rival weather; your Ice slow +10%
text.detail: Hail in your fights, for both sides: anyone not Ice loses HP every second. Your Ice Pokémon slow 10% more.

text.line: Your weather wins and is +50% stronger
text.detail: If the foe brings another weather, yours wins. What your weather gives your moves and the damage it deals to foes: +50%.

text.line: Your team regens 0.6% HP per second
Your team gains +2 Energy per second
Each ability cast: your abilities +3% damage
text.detail: Each time one of your Pokémon casts its ability, your whole team gains +3% ability damage until the combat ends.
When an ally falls, your Pokémon next to it gain +15% attack speed until the fight ends. It stacks.

text.line: Your Normal also gain your top trait
text.detail: With the Normal trait active, your Normal Pokémon also gain your top trait and its bonus, without adding to its count.
With the Fire trait active, when a burned foe falls, the foes next to it get burned for 3s.

text.line: Your Grass heal neighbors 50% (×2 in sun)
text.detail: With the Grass trait active, every second each Grass Pokémon heals adjacent allies 50% of what it regenerates (×2 in sun).

text.line: Your Electric discharges jump to 1 more foe
text.detail: With the Electric trait active, the trait’s discharge also jumps to 1 more foe, up to 2 tiles away.
With the Ice trait active, the 5th slowing hit on the same foe freezes it for 1.5s. Once per foe.

text.line: Your Fighting: +4% per hit on the same foe
text.detail: With the Fighting trait active, each basic in a row by a Fighting Pokémon on the same foe adds +4% damage. Switching foes resets it.
With the Poison trait active, the poison your team applies deals 25% more damage for every second it has been on.
With Ground active, at the start and at 10s each Ground Pokémon hits foes within 2 tiles: 4% of its HP, −10 Energy.
With the Flying trait active, your Flying Pokémon get +10% attack speed, and each dodge gives +15% more until the fight ends.
With the Psychic trait active, each ability of your Psychic Pokémon drains 10 Energy from every foe it hits.

text.line: A Bug falls: a larva hatches at 40% HP
text.detail: With the Bug trait active, when one of your Bug Pokémon falls, a cost-1 Bug larva hatches in its place with 40% HP.

text.line: Your Rock return 15% of damage taken
text.detail: With Rock active, your Rock hit attackers back for 15% of the HP they lose. Not shields or damage over time.

text.line: Ally falls: its killer loses 15% HP
text.detail: With the Ghost trait active, when an ally falls, whoever knocked it out loses 15% of the fallen ally’s max HP.
With the Dragon trait active, every 3s your whole team gains +2% Attack and Sp. Atk. It stacks all fight long.
Your Pokémon that have 2 types gain +9% HP and +9% damage.

text.line: 6+ of a type: those +25% HP and damage
text.detail: If you have 6 or more Pokémon of the same type on the board, those Pokémon gain +25% HP and +25% damage.
At 10s into combat, each of your tanks still standing heals 20% of its max HP.
Your marksmen: +1 tile of range and +10% attack speed.
The heals and shields your supports give to other allies are 30% stronger.
Your fighters gain +0.5% damage for each 1% of HP they are missing: the more hurt, the harder they hit.

text.line: Tanks take 25% of adjacent damage, +25% def.
text.detail: Your tanks take 25% of the damage dealt to allies next to them (not other tanks), and gain +25% Defense and Sp. Def.

text.line: Assassins: sure crit on foes below 50%
text.detail: Your assassins’ basic attacks and abilities always crit against foes below 50% HP.
Every 3rd basic attack of each of your marksmen deals +80% damage.
Every time one of your marksmen casts its ability, it gets back 30% of its max Energy.

text.line: Each support on board: team +8% damage
text.detail: Your whole team gains +8% damage for each support you have on the board.
Magikarp, Voltorb, Ditto and Mew gain +30% HP and damage, and each one counts twice toward its trait.

text.line: With 4 roles: all +7% HP, damage, def.
text.detail: If your board has 4 different roles (tank, marksman, fighter, assassin, support), your whole team gets +7% HP, damage and defenses.

text.line: Assassins hidden 3s; after a KO, they leap
text.detail: Your assassins start combat invisible for 3s. After each KO, 1s more of invisibility and they leap to the foe with the least HP.

text.line: Marksmen: after the 3rd ability, full Energy
text.detail: When each marksman casts its 3rd ability, it refills all its Energy and casts again right after. Once per fight.
Your tanks: +15% HP, and +6% more forever for each fight they survive. Your Pokémon take 5% less damage per adjacent tank.
Your Pokémon starting in the front row, the one closest to the foe, gain +15% Defense and Sp. Def.
When combat starts, your front-row Pokémon get a shield of 14% of their max HP that lasts until it breaks.
Your Pokémon starting in the back row, the one farthest from the foe, deal +18% damage.

text.line: Golden tile: +15% HP, damage and speed
text.detail: One tile of your half, marked in gold, changes every stage. Whoever starts combat on it: +15% HP, damage and attack speed.

text.line: In the 4 corners: +30% HP and damage
text.detail: Your Pokémon starting in one of the 4 corners of your half of the board: +30% HP and +30% damage.
If 3 or more allies start in the same column, all of them gain +20% attack speed.
Your Pokémon that start with no ally next to them gain +30% damage and +15% dodge.

text.line: Each adjacent ally: +4% damage and defenses
text.detail: Each of your Pokémon gains +4% damage and +4% Defense and Sp. Def. for each ally next to it at the start.

text.line: Edges: +35% attack speed, hunt the back row
text.detail: Your Pokémon in the edge columns: +35% attack speed, and they go first for the foe farthest back.

text.line: Front row: can’t be moved, −10% damage taken
text.detail: Your front row can’t be pushed, pulled or thrown, and takes 10% less damage.
Allies next to the Pokémon that starts in the center of your 2nd row gain +15% HP, damage, attack speed and defenses.

text.line: Magikarp shiny; Gyarados +25% Attack per fallen foe
text.detail: Gives you a shiny Magikarp. Once it is Gyarados (2★ or 3★), it gains +25% Attack for every foe that falls in the fight.

text.line: Unevolved Eevee 1★: also Water, Electric, Fire
text.detail: Gives you an Eevee 1★. While it stays unevolved (at 1★, or kept as Eevee), it also counts as Water, Electric and Fire.

text.line: Ditto 1★: copies items too, replacing its own
text.detail: Gives you a Ditto 1★. On transforming it also copies the foe’s items, replacing its own; if the foe has none, it keeps them.

text.line: Snorlax 1★: alive at the end, +3% HP forever
text.detail: Gives you a Snorlax 1★. Every fight it survives, it gains +3% max HP forever (lost if you sell it).

text.line: Chansey 1★: alive after a fight, +2 gold
text.detail: Gives you a Chansey 1★. Every fight it survives, +2 gold.
Your Pikachu never evolve into Raichu. They gain HP, damage, speed and defenses: +15% at 1★, +30% at 2★ and +45% at 3★.

text.line: Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan; together: +15% dmg, speed
text.detail: Gives you Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan 1★, whichever you lack. With both on the board, both gain +15% damage and attack speed.
Gives you Bulbasaur, Charmander or Squirtle 1★. With all 3 lines on the board, each gains +40% HP and damage.
Gives you a Dratini 1★. At any ★, its Dragon passive counts twice: another +25% HP, damage and attack speed.
Gives you a Tauros 1★. Each KO it lands in a fight: +20% attack speed and +10% damage. It stacks.
Gives you a Magnemite 1★. Its line deals +15% damage for each Electric ally next to it when combat starts.
Gives you a Gastly 1★. Its line gains +12% HP and +20% ability damage.
Gives you an Exeggcute 1★. Every time its line casts its ability, it gets back 35% of its max Energy.

text.line: Scyther 1★: after a KO, leaps to another foe
text.detail: Gives you a Scyther 1★. Every time it knocks out a foe, it leaps next to the foe with the least HP.

text.line: Staryu 1★: −25% from the foe’s top type
text.detail: Gives you a Staryu 1★. Its line takes 25% less damage from foes of the enemy team’s most common type. Its types don’t change.
Gives you a Voltorb 1★. When its line faints, its own Charge explosion hits 50% harder and reaches 1 tile farther.
Gives you a Cubone 1★. Cubone and Marowak start every fight with +40% Attack.

text.line: Mew 1★: counts as your top type
text.detail: Gives you a Mew 1★. It counts as your most common trait it doesn’t have: +1 to that trait.
